name: skill-sync-dsh
description: DeepSeek Harness skill bundle that checks the upstream skill version of skill plugins built from open-source skill repositories and rebuilds them into installable tarballs. Skill-only bundle; the update path never touches the profile.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');let n=0;const walk=d=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name==='__pycache__'){fs.rmSync(f,{recursive:true,force:true});n++;}else walk(f);}else if(/\.py[co]$/.test(e.name)){fs.unlinkSync(f);n++;}}};walk('skills');console.log(n?'[prepack] removed '+n+' python bytecode artifact(s)':'[prepack] no python bytecode to remove');"
